pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with relatively sharp edge gradients. Patches on the central flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to smaller, more fragmented patches appearing on the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a complete lattice. Pathways exhibit consistent thickness with well-defined junction nodes connecting multiple patch vertices across the visible flank.
